title: Understanding the Reduce Phase
text: In the reduce phase of MapReduce, the goal is to aggregate or summarize the data. Each reducer processes all records associated with a particular key.

title: Key-Value Pair Distribution
text: During the reduce phase, all records with the same key are sent to the same reducer. This ensures that all related data is processed together.

title: Confirming the Statement
